name: south-africa-hr-corpus
description: South Africa HR and administration corpus covering labour law (BCEA/LRA/EEA), payroll & social security (PAYE/UIF/SDL/COIDA), visa & immigration, B-BBEE & employment equity, company registration & admin, CCMA dispute resolution, office facilities, occupational health safety, and Chinese enterprise practice. 114 markdown files with TF-IDF + semantic index (9 newly added on 2026-07-28 to cover admin SOP / employee handbook / attendance / remote work / facilities / restraint-of-trade).
corpusPathNote: Relative to the expert package's references/ directory. Do NOT hardcode an installation root — the package may be installed under any marketplace, a project-level .workbuddy/, or a plain unzipped folder. All scripts resolve paths from __file__, so the package works from any location.

accessMethod.description: Corpus files are permanently inside the expert package. Use search_corpus.py for TF-IDF retrieval, or Read/Grep/Glob tools for direct file access. No unzip, no deployment, no network required.
accessMethod.pathResolution: Every script derives its own directory via Path(__file__).resolve().parent, so the corpus is located relative to the package itself on any OS and at any install location.
accessMethod.thirdPartyDependency: None required. sklearn/scipy/numpy are used opportunistically when present; when absent, search_corpus.py builds a pure-Python TF-IDF index at runtime from chunks_metadata.json (~130ms for 583 chunks).

selfContainmentStatement: 100% self-contained and permanently ready. No zip, no API keys, no cloud credentials, no network connection required. Corpus files are physically inside the expert package and travel with it to any computer.

statistics.indexMode: sklearn TF-IDF (auto-fallback to pure Python if sklearn unavailable)
